name: knoux-grabflow-vscode
description: Inspect HLS/DASH manifests, generate safe FFmpeg commands, and run local GrabFlow stream assembly from VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The companion runs a local Python helper and local FFmpeg/FFprobe against user-supplied URLs.

commands.title: KNOuX GrabFlow: Inspect Stream / Media URL
KNOuX GrabFlow: Assemble HLS/DASH Stream via Companion
KNOuX GrabFlow: Copy FFmpeg Assembly Command

knouxGrabflow.ffmpegPath.description: Absolute path to local FFmpeg, or a bare name resolved to an absolute path. The child process never inherits the caller's PATH.

knouxGrabflow.ffprobePath.description: Absolute path to local FFprobe, or a bare name resolved to an absolute path. The child process never inherits the caller's PATH.

knouxGrabflow.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used for companion assembly. Leave empty to use an auto-detected absolute path; a bare name is never resolved through an inherited PATH.

knouxGrabflow.companionScriptPath.description: Optional absolute path to assemble_stream.py. Leave empty to use the script bundled in the extension, then the repository checkout.
